analysis:
Examined both cluster-guide excerpts, configuration metadata and every configuration patch hunk. These are documentation changes; runtime enforcement and platform authorization are not supplied, so no implementation regression is independently established.

The principal integration question is qualification authority: docs/reference/configuration.md:923 onward changes runtime facts from operator-copied digests to release-published grants and parity qualifications used to derive approvals. The new text explicitly permits public GLM/Qwen mode-family promotion across unmeasured placements and acknowledges missing cross-cable evidence for some declared modes. Review ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts, ClusterPublicModels, release publication and the coordinator's acceptance/derivation together against A-005, A-011, A-017, T-054 and T-056: establish whether publication credentials can confer serving qualification, what independent approval authorizes the declaration, and whether the canonical model needs a distinct cluster-qualification authority/provenance boundary. Documentation alone does not establish bypass of App Attest or independent build qualification.

The assistant policy adds a fail-closed local/public separation (docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md:77-94; configuration patch at head:1631 onward); validate discovery, saved-config validation and approval attachment together. The guide adds pre-output grammar refusal and assumes platform failover (:96-104); verify refusal cannot leak partial output or cause duplicate billing. Approval fallback now excludes negotiation failures from quick-end counts and retries the same approval after an hour (:182-191); verify resumed admission still requires current authorization (T-053), rather than treating saved approval as permission.

Manual pair updates (:526-552) leave the service on its original release until login while workers are refreshed; review mixed-version control/worker compatibility and stale qualification handling. Surrounding documentation retains keyed-link startup, scoped encrypted caches (:489-494), token-required local HTTP exposure, and cache purge on unpair; no changed encryption/cache control is demonstrated (T-008, T-041).
